parts.t: This charming 4-bedroom rancher is nestled in a quiet cul-de-sac, making it an ideal family home or investment property. Boasting 2,045 SQFT of living space on a generous 4,026 SQFT lot, this residence offers ample room for comfort and convenience. The property features a double garage with space for four vehicles, ensuring parking is never a hassle. Its superb location is within walking distance to restaurants, shops, and the West Coast Express train station, making daily life convenient and enjoyable. Enjoy picturesque views to the south, encompassing the cityscape, bridge, and more. This well-built home is suitable for first-time buyers, seniors looking for a comfortable haven, or savvy investors seeking a promising opportunity. Don't miss out on this fantastic offering!"
